fusions.name: Tainted Bit
fusions.desc: A chop with a musk-wet blade that deals 4 damage and leaves the cut [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Warned Once, Felled
fusions.desc: Holds the blade raised for 1.5 seconds, then swings a full circle, dealing 34 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Scored in the Dirt
fusions.desc: Chops a line 5 tiles long into the ground and fills it with musk for 8 seconds. Anything that crosses it is [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Spatter from the Cut
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, musk spatters from the cut onto the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 7 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
